objectives.title: Make self-evolution productive on hosted runners
acceptance: self-improvement is distinct from product work
model attempts are bounded and reserve verification time
timeout and no-progress evidence drives a concrete efficiency improvement
Aider cannot edit protected or out-of-scope paths
constraints: remain Gemini-free and provider-free in product runtime
preserve no-auto-commit, rollback, scope, audit, production and verification gates
do not modify protected paths, workflows, safety verifiers, package manifests or objective definitions during the autonomous pass
do not wait indefinitely for a model call

objectives.title: Make AutoBot measure itself and choose better next work
acceptance: planner derives measurable efficiency and outcome signals
next action is deterministic and evidence-driven
planner can distinguish improve, investigate and plateau
safety and scope controls cannot be weakened
constraints: do not claim improvement without measured evidence

objectives.title: Make the sustained controller allocate time intelligently
acceptance: completed self-improvement advances to another eligible objective
time allocation responds to measured outcomes
no-progress cannot create an infinite hot loop

objectives.title: Strengthen recovery from model and partial-edit failures
acceptance: partial edits are rolled back safely
timeout and process failures remain distinguishable
repeated failure cannot silently become success
constraints: never weaken scope or protected paths

objectives.title: Improve cinematic edit quality end to end
acceptance: purposeful shot timing motion and transition intent
renderer consumes plan without black frames or timing regressions

objectives.title: Improve editor lifecycle reliability
acceptance: truthful loading error and recovery states
saved metadata restores into real editor state
missing local media is explicit and recoverable
constraints: never persist File Blob or object URLs as durable media

objectives.title: Improve creator export delivery
constraints: do not alter director or renderer implementation

objectives.title: Strengthen the universal executable timeline
acceptance: timeline preserves source identity and editorial roles
timing trims transforms speed and transitions remain executable

objectives.title: Strengthen real AI generation runtime and provider handoff
acceptance: moving-media requests use real video generation or truthful unavailable state
generated assets are validated before editing
constraints: never substitute stills for requested motion

objectives.title: Improve music arrangement and audio synchronisation
acceptance: beat or cue metadata can drive editorial timing
audio failures are explicit and recoverable

objectives.title: Improve universal creative brief understanding and continuity
acceptance: arbitrary subjects and worlds compile into coherent intent
camera action mood and constraints remain explicit
constraints: do not invent unsupported production capabilities

objectives.title: Improve Android/PWA editing usability
constraints: do not redesign unrelated product areas
